## 1. Mandate

Pillar 3's eighth decision-record scenario. The scoping pass (a read-only
survey re-verified line by line against the live tree) selected the one
shipped decision face with a documented contract and provably zero prior
coverage in any lane: the exported **partition face**
`ms_cluster_signatures` (`R/ms-cluster.R`; exported at `NAMESPACE` -- the
threshold-graph connected components of the cosine matrix with
mean-cosine medoids). Its zero-coverage finding was established by call-site
inventory: no benchmark lane, scenario or law constructs it. Rails held:
decision-record framing only, the exported face only, planted truth as the
only ground, no new estimation machinery, the whole scenario RNG-free -- no
seed to pin, no draw to re-roll.

## 2. The planted question

The face answers one question per threshold: which columns belong to the
same cluster, given the edge law "cosine finite and at least the
threshold", with which cluster representative (medoid) speaks for each
cluster -- the member of highest mean within-cluster cosine, SELF-EXCLUSIVE,
ties falling to the first member, a singleton its own medoid. The shipped
default threshold (0.90, read from the face's own formals) is CITED, never an
anchor: the module header law is that cosine above it remains necessary, not
sufficient, so the scenario records what the face DOES on planted truth,
never what a clustering means biologically.

The scenario plants a nine-column SBS96-subset cohort of exact-duplicate
families (bundled bytes; roster SBS1/SBS2/SBS13/SBS88 at family sizes
3/2/2/2, measured separable: worst cross-family cosine 0.0707) and drives
five arms through the exported face alone: the clean cohort, a jittered
family-1 whose center member must win its medoid STRICTLY, a channel-rotated
artifakt (family 2 scrambled), a degenerate all-zero column, and a
deterministic corruption ladder blending every member toward its own
rotated twin across eight rungs.

Two structural laws were MEASURED, not assumed, and the law test mirrors
the measured behaviour byte for byte:

- **The label law is ascending-root, not size-ordered.** The shipped
  labeling sorts cluster sizes decreasing but double-indexes -- the label
  permutation and the name permutation cancel, so the committed labels are
  the ascending ROOT order and cluster sizes play no role at all. The
  scoping report's claim that labels follow descending size was REFUTED by
  a zero-arm measurement (the size-one singleton F3a keeps label C3 ahead
  of the size-two F4 pair's C5) and the shipped source was then read
  verbatim to confirm the round-trip. The hand re-derivation engine in the
  law test implements the MEASURED contract, not the header's intent.
- **The match bit is structural.** A member matches the committed roster
  iff its co-membership set and its cluster size both agree -- never on
  cross-arm label equality, because the ascending-root law renumbers every
  survivor's label whenever any arm adds or drops a cluster (the artifakt
  arm's F4 pair renumbering when family 2 splinters is the proof case).

## 3. Measured results

- **Hard rails held.** The clean partition IS the planted family map --
  labels C1..C4, sizes 3/2/2/2, each family's medoid its first member (the
  tie law spoken exactly); the scrambled pair are lawful, DISTINCT-label
  singletons at the cited line and at every swept threshold; the seven
  untouched members keep the committed verdict under every perturbation;
  `threshold = 0` aborts on the input topic through the face's own
  validation (`msuiter_error_input`).
- **The medoid is won, not tie-won.** The jittered family's center member
  wins its medoid with a measured margin of 1.96e-04 over both siblings --
  far beyond the ulp tier -- under the face's self-exclusive mean rule.
  This arm nearly died at design time: the FIRST jitter design pushed
  three entries negative and the face's own non-negative input check
  ABORTED it -- a probe that had bypassed the face would have shipped an
  untestable plant. The lesson (probes must traverse the real face) is
  banked with the design: the committed jitter sits on measured peak
  channels whose masses survive the shift.
- **The zero column speaks its law.** The all-zero member is a lawful
  medoid singleton, its former twin becomes a lawful family of one, and
  the cosine matrix carries exactly 17 NaN cells (9 plus 9 minus the
  shared corner) -- re-derived, not hardcoded, by both runner and law.
- **The committed ladder fact.** The corruption ladder is monotone
  non-increasing, rung 0 reproduces the clean arm, and its last full-pass
  rung is committed at 0.23 as an OBSERVED fact at the frozen plant --
  bracketed by probe (at 0.23 every within-family pair still stands at or
  above 0.9182; at 0.26 five pairs fall below 0.90 while the F4 twin pair
  survives at 0.9030, taking the cluster count to eight). Never asserted
  a priori, never generalized.
- **The one-ulp posture again.** The face's own diagonal cosine measures
  one ulp BELOW unity (0.99999999999999989) on this platform's sqrt
  path while duplicated columns read exactly 1.0 -- the mathematically
  closed domain is not representation-closed, so the pre-write census
  demands finite in-domain bytes with the 4-eps slack rather than
  exact-equality floats, per the cross-platform posture (integer verdict
  bytes byte-frozen, float columns censused and dual-derived).
- **A false-green DET caught by its own gate.** The first determinism
  attestation hashed ZERO files -- the witness directory had been cleaned
  and an empty hash set compares equal to an empty hash set. The attestation
  now refuses below a hard six-file count before hashing, and the
  committed `DET=IDENTICAL` is a census over six named witnesses from
  independent ignitions.

The law row joined the shard roster (weight 1 s, 134 expects); the

(`nb=134 failed=0 error=0`) recorded verbatim in
